name: workflow-toolbox
description: Toolbox for Claude Code's Workflow tool — author deterministic multi-agent workflow scripts (workflow-composer, with the @workflow-toolbox compile-time pattern toolkit as its standard library), scaffold a build-clean workflow skeleton from a spec (toolkit-scaffold), diagnose a failed run from its journal and decide whether resumeFromRunId helps (workflow-debugger), re-verify the runtime surface after a Claude Code upgrade (upgrade-canary), run a bias-free multi-lens analysis of any subject when relevant (independent-analysis), and run a deep-grounding pass that collects and verifies evidence against the real sources before asserting or analyzing (deep-grounding), and install, check, and migrate editable, versioned copies of the plugin's own rules and agent definitions into a project's or user's config directory (adopt). Ships the independent-analysis workflow that skill triggers (domain-agnostic adversarial multi-lens analysis), a Stop hook that auto-surfaces a finished Workflow run's cost + traceability audit report (always a notice; grabs the session when the run looks like trouble, was degraded by a silently-denied tool call, or requested external delegation whose agents show no real external-CLI invocation), and a tracker-agnostic actionability Stop gate that blocks only while startable work remains with nothing running, paired with a Planka producer that writes the snapshot it reads automatically from board-reading tool calls (never a guess: it stays silent on a partial read or on a project with no Depends-on convention). Also ships the pilot agent suite (pilot / pilot-orchestrator / pilot-watchdog) and the pilot-wave composer skill for driving tracked task-tracker cards by delegation, plus a conditional SessionStart hook that injects a generic delegation ladder where a project does tracked/delegated work and points at the delegation-chain skill (a non-user-invocable reference on spawn shapes, the upward report chain, wake signals, and what each shipped watcher/guard does and does not cover) before a delegation decision is made. Ships two Planka kanban skills for any project that wants board-based task tracking: planka-tracking (onboard a project — create the board, migrate an existing progress.md into cards, write the pointer) and what-next (propose the logical next step from that board, or from progress.md/conversation when there's no board), both requiring only a reachable planka MCP server.

grounding_sources.title: Deep-grounding user source registry
grounding_sources.description: JSON source registry merged between plugin defaults and .claude/grounding-sources.json. Empty uses the Claude config directory fallback.

grounding_prompt_cooldown.title: Deep-grounding reminder cooldown
grounding_prompt_cooldown.description: Prompt count between short deep-grounding reminders after the first prompt.

grounding_pre_send.title: Deep-grounding outbound check mode
grounding_pre_send.description: observe journals what the guard would decide without blocking; refuse blocks once; off disables it.

grounding_outbound_tools.title: Additional outbound tool patterns
grounding_outbound_tools.description: Comma- or newline-separated MCP tool-name globs treated as outbound claim sends.

executor_lane_consent.title: Allow executor lane
executor_lane_consent.description: Account consent is the ceiling and project settings may only narrow it.

adopt_refresh.title: Adopt refresh owner
adopt_refresh.description: Use notice-only on a non-writer session to hand stale-copy action to the session that owns the directory.

lane_skills.title: Executor lane skills
lane_skills.description: Comma- or newline-separated Claude skill names allowed in external OpenCode lanes.

lane_models.title: Executor lane models
lane_models.description: Comma- or newline-separated exact provider/model allow-list for external OpenCode lanes.

artifact_server.title: Enable artifact server
artifact_server.description: Start or attach the per-session artifact-server monitor.

artifact_server_roots.title: Artifact server roots
artifact_server_roots.description: Comma- or newline-separated name=path or bare-path roots; unset uses project-local defaults.

artifact_server_port.title: Artifact server port
artifact_server_port.description: First candidate port; unset derives a stable per-user port from 48000-48999.

artifact_server_idle_grace_s.title: Artifact server idle grace
artifact_server_idle_grace_s.description: Seconds to retain dead-session registrations before shutdown.

artifact_server_deny.title: Additional artifact deny patterns
artifact_server_deny.description: Comma- or newline-separated basename glob patterns added to the security deny list.

planka_mcp_url.title: Planka MCP URL for SDK pilots
planka_mcp_url.description: HTTP MCP endpoint of the Planka board that SDK pilots and the SDK orchestrator use. Empty: no board tools.

second_opinion_fable_max_pct.title: Legacy second-opinion Fable quota ceiling
second_opinion_fable_max_pct.description: Retained so existing settings remain valid; ignored now that the Claude second-opinion route uses Opus instead of Fable.

lane_orphan_cleanup.title: Attributed lane orphan cleanup mode
lane_orphan_cleanup.description: observe journals would-clean evidence without signaling; enforce terminates exact re-verified attributed lane orphans.

lane_stall_minutes.title: Lane worktree stall threshold
lane_stall_minutes.description: Minutes without a worktree write before a still-running supervised lane is reported to its owner with evidence; it is never killed for this condition.

release_branch.title: Release branch
release_branch.description: Release branch guarded at push time when the remote default branch is unavailable. Empty falls back to main/master.

executor_review_model.title: Executor review model

executor_refutation_model.title: Executor refutation model

configDir.title: Claude configuration directory
configDir.description: Absolute plugin-store root. Empty uses CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, then the session home.

livenessDir.title: Running-work liveness directory
livenessDir.description: Absolute liveness-record directory. Empty uses XDG_STATE_HOME/wt-liveness or the home state directory.

suiteRoot.title: Running-work suite root
suiteRoot.description: Absolute root containing configured worktrees and reports. Empty uses .claude under the session project.

extraRoots.title: Additional running-work roots
extraRoots.description: Comma- or newline-separated absolute roots trusted for external lanes.

pollMs.title: Running-view polling interval
pollMs.description: Milliseconds between snapshots while the What is running pane is open.

collectorTimeoutMs.title: Running-view collection timeout
collectorTimeoutMs.description: Maximum milliseconds for one What is running collection. The pane keeps its last snapshot and retries after a timeout.

activeWindowMin.title: Running-work activity window
activeWindowMin.description: Minutes for which durable activity evidence remains current.

linkBase.title: Running-work artifact URL
linkBase.description: Optional https: or http://localhost static server base URL serving artifacts below suiteRoot.

plankaBaseUrl.title: Planka browser URL
plankaBaseUrl.description: Optional browser-facing Planka base URL used for card links.

plankaConfigFile.title: Planka environment file
plankaConfigFile.description: Optional absolute environment file from which BASE_URL is read when Planka browser URL is empty.
